tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background on every page. The veil of the hero light fades into it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the header bar when stuck, the install snippet frame on light pages.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Inset panels: the hero trace panel, StatBadge fill, CrossLinks strip.

tokens.name: terminal
tokens.usage: Terminal and code panels. Dark in both themes on purpose: the real tools print here. Text on it uses term-ink, term-muted, term-prompt only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and card outlines that only separate. Decorative: never the only thing that marks a control (use line-strong).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mark a control (ghost button, copy button, search input) at 3:1 on ground, surface and sunk.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on ground, surface and sunk (16:1 / 14:1 and up).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on ground, surface and sunk (6.2:1 and up in both themes).

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Project hue of the profile hub (from its favicon and the old --accent). As text on ground, surface and sunk; as a fill only under on-rust.

tokens.name: on-rust
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a rust fill (the hub's primary button).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Project hue of AgEnFK Squad (its --accent and the watcher-ring favicon). As text on ground, surface and sunk; as a fill only under on-green.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a green fill.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Project hue of AgentCenter as a FILL (its icon bar, its --brand). Never as small text in light: use amber-text.

tokens.name: amber-text
tokens.usage: AgentCenter's hue as text and links on ground, surface and sunk.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an amber fill.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Project hue of the AWS IaC Enterprise Library (its --violet and the favicon nodes). Solid only: never in a gradient. As text on ground, surface and sunk.

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a violet fill.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Needs attention: the pre-alpha StatBadge dot and word, a failed copy. Always with a word, never colour alone. As text on ground, surface and sunk.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 3px solid, 3px offset: 3:1 or better on ground, surface and sunk in both themes (the hub's own --focus values).

tokens.name: term-ink
tokens.usage: Code and command text on terminal.

tokens.name: term-muted
tokens.usage: Comments, captions and the window title on terminal.

tokens.name: term-prompt
tokens.usage: The prompt sign and the watcher's [squad-watch] tag on terminal.

tokens.name: art-haze-b
tokens.usage: Second haze ellipse of the hero light (the hub teal), under 0.16 alpha. Never text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The page's own project hue. Each page re-points this one alias (hub: rust, squad: green, AgentCenter: amber-text, IaC: violet); components read accent, never a hue by name.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: The page's project hue as a fill (primary button, trace trail). AgentCenter points it at amber, the others at their hue.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent-fill; re-pointed with it (on-green, on-amber, on-violet).

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Fill of the star call-to-action on every page: the same neutral button everywhere, so a visitor learns it once.

tokens.name: on-star
tokens.usage: Label and star glyph on the star fill.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links: an alias of accent, so a page that re-points accent moves its links.

families.mono: "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Archivo, variable width and weight (OFL 1.1). Display styles are set at font-stretch 118% (bundle.css .po-display); the width axis is not a token field.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one hero h1 per page at 1280; clamps to 48px at 400 (bundle.css). Never twice on a page.

styles.name: display-l
styles.sample: Know what every coding agent costs your machine.
styles.usage: Product heroes whose h1 is a sentence (squad, AgentCenter, IaC); clamps to 38px at 400.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Public-safe examples, operational guidance and a small set of developer tools.
styles.usage: The hero's one supporting line, in ink-muted, max 54ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A squad of Claude Code agents and a watcher hook that keeps parallel AI sessions honest.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Source-available under FSL-1.1-ALv2; converts to Apache 2.0 later.

groups.name: Instrument
groups.note: Martian Mono (OFL 1.1), width 87.5 for code (bundle.css), 100 for labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, status words, StatBadge, card toplines. Uppercase only here.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: One measured number with a source (StatBadge large). Tabular figures.

spacing.note: 4px base. Section rhythm uses space-9 on desktop, space-8 on phone.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, StatBadge inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; inside badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; between label and title.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter at 400px; card padding on phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side gutter from 720px; heading to content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between hero copy and its actions block; trace panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on phone.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

radius.note: Small and firm: instruments, not pillows. Panels and rules are square.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Hero trace panel, section rules, terminal panels.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, copy button, StatBadge.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: ProjectCard, FeatureGrid cells, InstallSnippet frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Only the status dot. No pill buttons.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. One shadow for the terminal panel and one focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Terminal and InstallSnippet frames only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus where an outline cannot follow the shape: a 3px ground gap, then 3px of solid focus. Elsewhere use outline: 3px solid focus, offset 3px.

opacity.note: The light layer, from house-style motion-and-light. Dark theme multiplies haze by 0.8; phone multiplies everything by 0.78.

tokens.name: art-haze
tokens.usage: Alpha of each haze ellipse (0.11 to 0.16 allowed).

tokens.name: art-band
tokens.usage: Peak opacity of the soft 30-unit band under each trace.

tokens.name: art-line
tokens.usage: Peak stop of the 1-unit trace line gradient (stops 0.12, 0.5, 0.19, 0.33, 0.09).

tokens.name: art-trail-1
tokens.usage: Strength of the first travelling trail.

tokens.name: art-trail-2
tokens.usage: Second trail.

tokens.name: art-trail-3
tokens.usage: Third trail.

tokens.name: sweep-dark
tokens.usage: Strength of the star-button light sweep in the dark theme (full strength in light).

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Button press scale(0.97) and colour change.

tokens.name: dur-ui
tokens.usage: Copy-button state, card border on hover.

tokens.name: dur-sweep
tokens.usage: One star-button sweep, linear, 72px band from -400px to 400px.

tokens.name: dur-trail-1
tokens.usage: First trail along a trace, linear infinite, delay 0.

tokens.name: dur-trail-2
tokens.usage: Second trail, delay -8s.

tokens.name: dur-trail-3
tokens.usage: Third trail, delay -17s.

tokens.name: dur-haze
tokens.usage: Haze drift, ease-in-out infinite alternate.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Anything entering or leaving (copy confirmation).

tokens.name: ease-move
tokens.usage: Something moving on screen.

tokens.name: ease-ambient
tokens.usage: Haze drift.

tokens.name: ease-constant
tokens.usage: Trails and the sweep.
